candidates.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
candidates.summary: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

candidates.title: Making Amazon Quick enterprise-ready: Automated, auditable cross-account resource promotion
candidates.summary: Promoting Amazon Quick resources (agents, action connectors, knowledge bases, flows, and spaces) from a development to a production AWS account has been a manual, error-prone chore. This post shows how to automate cross-account promotion with an idempotent, auditable MCP server on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

candidates.title: Evaluating multi-agent systems for explainability and helpfulness with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Multi-agent systems need deeper guarantees than fluent responses: they must select the right tools, respect constraints, and explain their decisions. Learn how to build a Strands-based multi-agent supply chain decisioning system and evaluate it with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations using built-in, custom, and explainability evaluators.

candidates.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
candidates.summary: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.

candidates.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
candidates.summary: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

candidates.title: Researchers are tracking a Chinese AI ‘agent fleet’
candidates.summary: Independent researchers discovered an agent swarm that seems to be running on Tencent's infrastructure and targeting Alibaba's map service, Amap.
